advisories: Overlap with the main checkout: C:\Users\Aaron\EveTradingbot (the live deployment this worktree was forked from) already carries a partial variant of this fix — the same SDE_TABLES constant, a _tables_populated() helper, and the `and _tables_populated(db)` no-op gate — but WITHOUT the fail-loud check and without the empty-stations and fail-loud tests. This worktree's implementation is a superset (reload gate + loud SdeError + 5 tests). When this branch is merged back, reconcile so SDE_TABLES/_tables_populated are not duplicated. This is an integration-time concern only; it does not affect the correctness of this change in isolation.

The fail-loud check raises after types/groups/systems have already been written but before stargates/stations/meta are written. This is a partial write on the error path, but it is harmless: the build stamp is NOT advanced on failure, so the next refresh re-runs the full load from the same bundle and rewrites everything. The important invariant (never stamp a build over an empty map) holds.

The fail-loud check runs on the `bundle_path` (operator-supplied local bundle) path too, not just the download path. A local bundle with no stargates or no NPC stations now raises instead of silently succeeding. This is intentional and matches 'do not report success with empty tables'; the real CCP SDE always contains both, and the only existing caller using a real bundle (the network smoke test) uses a complete one.

Environmental (not a code defect): the job's pinned interpreter is an editable install pointing at the main checkout's src, not this worktree. All test/lint runs used a PYTHONPATH override to the worktree's src so the worktree's code is what was exercised. Recorded in .qo/recon.md and .qo/build.txt.
summary: The change does exactly what the task asks and nothing more. (1) The same-build no-op in load_sde is now gated on _tables_populated(db): all five SDE tables the load fills must be non-empty, so a lake stamped with the current build but missing stargates/stations (the pre-H1a symptom) reloads via download_bundle — which reuses an already-downloaded bundle for that build without a network request. (2) A reload that still yields zero stargates or zero NPC stations raises SdeError BEFORE the sde_build stamp advances, so a broken bundle cannot be stamped into the trusted no-op path. Tests: five new offline cases in tests/test_sde_map.py, with latest_build and download_bundle monkeypatched (no network). Four of them (reload-on-empty-stargates, reload-on-empty-stations, fail-loud-no-gates, fail-loud-no-stations) FAILED before the change and pass after; the no-op case passes before and after by design (the no-op already worked — it is a regression guard against over-fixing). Full suite 1089 passed / 7 deselected (network), ruff check and ruff format clean. Scope is two files (sde.py, test_sde_map.py) plus the two required control files; no unrelated files touched, no git-history commands run, no network.
